generationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a production-ready transparent PNG sprite sheet of sculptural accent objects for a carefully designed personal portfolio.
Canvas: SQUARE, 2048 x 2048 pixels. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background throughout.
Layout: EXACTLY 16 separate, self-contained objects, in an exact evenly spaced 4-column by 4-row grid. Each cell is a 512 x 512 square. Object centers at the center of each cell. Every complete silhouette including tips and branches stays inside the central 72% of its cell, with generous transparent breathing room on every side. No visible grid lines, labels, numbers, frames, tile backgrounds, platforms, or connecting elements between cells. Each cell contains one grouped concept and nothing else. This is a sheet of cutout objects, not a website mockup.

Art direction: tactile, rich, meticulously crafted physical objects photographed in a soft studio. Real paper fibers, subtle botanical leaf veins, smooth matte ceramic, and powder-coated wire. A coherent visual family, common soft upper-left lighting and a gentle three-quarter perspective. Delicate detail but strong readable silhouettes at small sizes. Mature, understated fine-art objects rather than flat icons, cartoon emoji, glossy toys, game items, or an icon pack. Keep the mathematical glyphs recognizable and geometrically correct.

Color palette: exclusively high-chroma warm colors intended to pop against a pale BLUE-GREY #edf2f6 webpage. Main colors saturated orange-red / vermilion #ff5729, scarlet #ff3b24, tangerine #ff8725, with a few saffron / sun-yellow #ffc52c pieces. Colored material all the way through, with natural tonal variation, no global warm color cast. Most objects should be vermilion and orange, about four can be yellow. Avoid muted burnt orange, rust, terracotta, brown, beige, white, cold blue/green, gold metal, amber glass, metallic reflections, neon emission and outer glows.

Exact grid content, read left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
ROW 1, botanical:
1. One delicate vermilion fern frond with clearly separated pinnate leaflets and a gracefully curved stem.
2. One saffron-yellow ginkgo leaf, fan shaped, finely veined, short natural stem.
3. One tangerine unfurling fern fiddlehead, an elegant organic curled spiral with small emerging leaflets.
4. One scarlet-red small botanical twig with three beautifully shaped oval leaves, a single cohesive branch.

ROW 2, mathematical:
5. A clear summation operator, capital Greek sigma ∑, as a solid matte scarlet ceramic sculpture.
6. A single integral operator ∫, a tall elegant tangerine matte ceramic sculpture, correctly curved at both ends.
7. A correct infinity symbol ∞, one continuous smooth saffron-yellow loop with a clearly readable crossing and two open spaces.
8. A correct nabla / gradient operator ∇, an open inverted triangle made of thick vermilion matte ceramic strokes, with a clear triangular opening.

ROW 3, biological intelligence and computation:
9. A beautiful vermilion neuron: one soma, multiple fine branching dendrites and one longer axon, all contained in the cell and clearly readable.
10. A synapse as ONE grouped object: two organically branching neural terminals facing each other across a small visible gap, orange on one side, saffron on the other, no arrows or text.
11. A compact balanced binary tree: seven tangerine spheres joined by fine matte-orange rods, one root, two children, four leaves, a single connected physical graph.
12. A compact directed acyclic graph: six scarlet nodes connected by thin red rods with a few small sculptural arrowheads, branching and rejoining, coherent and uncluttered.

ROW 4, structures and abstractions:
13. A small feedforward neural network, three layers of 3, 4, and 2 small warm orange and yellow nodes, connected by fine warm wires, one cohesive physical object.
14. A vermilion Sierpinski triangle, a precise triangular fractal sculpture with clean nested triangular openings, no base.
15. A tangerine Möbius strip made of a single tactile folded-paper ribbon with one half twist, visibly elegant, not glossy.
16. A call-stack-inspired sculpture: four thin scarlet matte-paper slabs stacked with a slight orderly offset, one narrow saffron inner edge, no writing or numbers.

Technical constraints: actual transparent pixels outside every object and inside all open holes, NOT a white background and NOT a painted checkerboard. Clean anti-aliased alpha edges without white halos. Do not cast shadows onto any background plane; only restrained self-shadow and ambient occlusion within each object. No detached drop shadows, no backdrop, no text except the four requested mathematical operators as sculptural forms. No watermarks or logos. Do not crop any leaf tip, graph node, operator, or branch. EXACTLY FOUR rows and FOUR columns.
